en: work that a person is expected to do in a specified time

examples.text: This heavy workload is too much for me.

en: greet in a friendly way

en: large room used mainly for dancing
cn: 舞厅, 跳舞场

en: a subtle difference in meaning or opinion or attitude
cn: 细微差别

en: all of the same or similar kind or nature
cn: 同种的, 同质的, 齐性的

en: a treatise advancing a new point of view resulting from research; usually a requirement for an advanced academic degree
cn: 论文

en: a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body
cn: 绷带

en: leave one's country of residence for a new one
cn: (使)移居, (使)移民

en: the quality of being valueless or futile
cn: 虚荣心, 虚无, 自负, 空虚, 时髦的小摆饰

examples.text: The desire for love to be requited is demanded not by love but by vanity.

en: a thief who steals from someone by threatening violence
cn: 强盗, 盗贼

en: the area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
cn: 听众席, 礼堂

en: the condition of being honored (esteemed or respected or well regarded)
cn: 尊敬, 尊重

en: shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
cn: 振动, 颤动, 激动, 摇摆, 踌躇

en: large voracious aquatic reptile having a long snout with massive jaws and sharp teeth and a body covered with bony plates; of sluggish tropical waters
cn: 鳄鱼

examples.text: In 2014, a handler was dragged into the water by a crocodile, but escaped with minor injuries.

en: a short trip that is taken in the performance of a necessary task or mission
cn: 任务, 差使, 使命

examples.text: I have an errand to do in town.

en: loss of the ability to move a body part
cn: 麻痹, 停顿, 瘫痪

en: a strong current of air
cn: 突然一阵, 趣味, 爱好

examples.text: A strong gust of wind sent deep red maple leaves swirling around the couple's feet.

A gust of wind blew through the office, sending papers and small objects flying in every direction.

en: protect from heat, cold, or noise by surrounding with insulating material
cn: 使绝缘, 隔离

examples.text: You'll end up getting an electric shock if you don't insulate that wire.

Since we insulated the house we've saved a lot on heating oil.

en: abnormally large
cn: 巨大的, 畸形的, 怪异的

examples.text: An impressive silence broods over the monstrous structure where such multitudes of men and women were wont to assemble in other days.

The tip led the police to a monstrous crime.

en: make up something artificial or untrue
cn: 制造, 建造, 装配, 伪造

en: payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment
cn: 贿赂

en: a person motivated by irrational enthusiasm (as for a cause)
cn: 狂热者, 盲信

en: normal or sound powers of mind

Gaslighting can cause victims to question their own sanity.

en: terminate, end, or take out
cn: 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色

examples.text: The fire which seems extinguished is often dormant under the cinders; whoever wants to revive it may be in for a surprise.

Can the fire of the heart be extinguished in the flames of the funeral pile?

en: a shelf on which to keep books
cn: 书架

examples.text: By no means may you cut out the pictures from the books that have been placed on the bookshelf.

en: attach or add
cn: 邻接, 毗连

examples.text: What's the difference between adjoining and connecting rooms in a hotel?

We could hear people talking in the adjoining room.

en: a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
cn: 电学家, 电气技师, 电工

examples.text: It's illegal for anyone, other than a licensed electrician, to carry out any electrical work in your house.

en: feeling a need to see others suffer
cn: 恶意, 蓄意害人, 怨恨

examples.text: It doesn't need to be regarded as malice.

en: an irrational belief arising from ignorance or fear
cn: 迷信

examples.text: I will bring my children up in such a way that they will be protected from superstition.

I will raise my children so that they will be protected from superstition.

en: rules governing socially acceptable behavior
cn: 礼仪, 礼节, 成规

en: enthusiastic approval
cn: 喝彩, 欢呼, 赞同

examples.text: Not only did the movie receive critical acclaim, but it also broke box office records.

She was a brilliant scholar, receiving acclaim far and wide.

en: play around with or alter or falsify, usually secretively or dishonestly
cn: 干预, 拨弄, 贿赂, 损害, 篡改

examples.text: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

en: relating to or arranged according to temporal order

en: seize control of
cn: 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈

examples.text: Out of other avenues for escape, the desperate fugitive decided to hijack a dog sled.
If someone doesn't hijack something, it's not a good movie.

en: a piece of furniture with shelves for storing books
cn: 书架, 书柜

examples.text: There are a lot of dictionaries in the bookcase.

en: a water-resistant coat
cn: 雨衣

examples.text: If it had not been for your raincoat, I would have been drenched to the skin.

If it hadn't been for your raincoat, I would've been soaked to the bone.

en: a rapid change in brightness; a brief spark or flash
cn: 闪烁, 闪耀, 瞬息

en: of an incalculable amount

examples.text: In itself it was insignificant; it had, however, untold consequences.

en: treat with excessive indulgence
cn: 放纵, 使吃饱, 使过量

en: a long narrow depression in a surface
cn: 裂缝

examples.text: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.

en: be persistent, refuse to stop
cn: 坚持, 孜孜不倦, 不屈不挠, (辩论中)固执己见

examples.text: He's determined to persevere in his work on behalf of equality and human rights.

en: showing concern for the rights and feelings of others

en: one having charge of buildings or grounds or animals
cn: 管理人, 保管人, 监护人

en: a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt
cn: 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯

en: a medicinal or magical or poisonous beverage

en: a fully developed person from maturity onward

en: the act of exhibiting
